brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Six bases over levels 0 and 1 (piece:0,0,0 / 0,0,1 full and piece:1,0 and 2,0 half-n on both levels), capped with capOpenFaces and lockJoints (jointBolt:1#0,0#0)
Four drawers on half-base cut faces: drawer:0#1,0#cut, drawer:0#2,0#cut (level 0), drawer:1#1,0#cut, drawer:1#2,0#cut (level 1); two shown open

Open divided bin bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full-div2 on the top storey holding M3 screw and nut heaps (prop:1, prop:4), covers cover:0,0,1, cover:1,0,1, cover:2,0,1 with tape measure (prop:2) and hex driver set (prop:3) staged on top

finish.summary: Built a two-storey, three-cell-wide tower: full base left with a divided open bin on top, half bases centre and right carrying four drawers (two per storey, two shown open), capped open faces, bolted joints, and dressed with screws/nuts, tape and hex driver set. check_build is clear with no issues.

M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Building your two-storey workbench tower with drawers — first checking the current build and available drawer options.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base first. Half-n and half-s take any drawer style; half-e and half-w take a slide, swing or long drawer (find_sockets offers those once the half base is on). No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
